instruction: Switch the unit of measurement to centimeters in the LibreOffice Impress preferences.

metadata.explanation: This task requires changing the measurement unit setting in LibreOffice Impress from default to centimeters. Unit codes: 3=mm, 6=cm, 8=inch. The evaluator checks the registrymodifications.xcu file for the MeasureUnit value under /org.openoffice.Office.Impress/Layout/Other. Similar complexity to original - both are single setting changes in Options dialog.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement - checks if measurement unit is set to centimeters (unit code 6)
Getter logic is correct - fetches the LibreOffice config file (/home/user/.config/libreoffice/4/user/registrymodifications.xcu) where measurement settings are stored
Metric logic is semantically correct - parses XML, navigates to correct path (/org.openoffice.Office.Impress/Layout/Other), checks MeasureUnit property, and compares value
Parameter handling is correct - metric receives rules dict directly (not wrapped), accesses rules['unit'] properly
Expected value is semantically correct - unit code 6 corresponds to centimeters as required by instruction
Complete coverage - evaluator checks exactly what the instruction requires (measurement unit change to cm)
State is accessible - config file is persistent and available after task completion, no postconfig needed
Robust error handling - handles XML parse errors, file not found, and missing values gracefully
